evidence: X-ray diffraction (XRD) measurements were performed with monochromatic Cu K a (l ¼ 1.54 A˚ ) radiation. The atomic force microscope (AFM; Veeco, Digital Instruments) in tapping mode was used to investigate the surface morphology of the films. Room temperature Hall measurements were carried on using the RH2035 PhysTech GmbH system with a magnet field B ¼ 0.4 T. Optical transmission spectra were measured in the wavelength range 300–1 100 nm using the CM2203 spectrometer. Photoluminescence (PL) spectra were measured in the range 340–820 nm with the excitation wavelength of 300 nm. Cross-section images as well as electron dispersive X-ray (EDX) measurements were carried on for ZnO grown on Si and glass substrates using the Hitachi SU-70 scanning electron microscope.
